mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_knowledge_base where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted_at is null
select * from ai_knowledge_base where status = 'ACTIVE' and updated_at < current_timestamp - interval '90 days' and deleted_at is null order by updated_at asc
select status, count(*) as count from ai_knowledge_base where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted_at is null group by status
select * from ai_knowledge_base where owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and deleted_at is null order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update ai_knowledge_base set document_count = #{documentCount}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, vector_count = #{vectorCount}, total_size_bytes = #{totalSizeBytes}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
